name: Iruma Jyuto
source: A police sergeant at the Yokohama Police Department's Organized Crime Division. A corrupt police officer familiar with the world of the Yakuza, he is not afraid to conduct illegal investigations to achieve his goals. Having lost both his parents to drug addicts and a friend to drug addiction, he aims to eradicate illegal drugs. After learning about the corruption within the Chuo District and the upper echelons of the police, he plots to change the organization.
